description: This file defines classes, constants, and interfaces for HDMI CEC management within a plugin framework, including device info structures, processing classes, and plugin lifecycle management with JSON RPC interface.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2FrameListener
classes.description: Implements FrameListener to handle incoming CEC frames and pass them to the processor.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2Processor
classes.description: Processes various HDMI CEC messages, handling device communication.

classes.name: CECDeviceInfo_2
classes.description: Stores and manages information about a CEC device, including address, vendor ID, and OSD name.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing HDMI CEC control, exposing JSON RPC methods, managing device list, and handling IARM events.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Handles incoming CEC frames and forwards to processing.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes specific CEC messages based on their type.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the device info to default values.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates device info fields and returns whether they were changed.
